family: A3 task 15b (end-of-run comparison, old e2e suites and evidence closure before UAT)
source: Brief TASK-115-a1; RUNNING-SUMMARY “UAT items so far” and every merged task’s rules.forTask115 / rules.retiredAssertions; round-07 placement review (N8, N10, N11) and scan finding S6; the corrected task 2 groundwork ledger (e2e table: the 63 old-build e2e files).

rules.matchersWeakenedNote: No read was dropped or loosened: task-021 keeps the base’s loop read, restores the build’s data-urgent read and reads Round 7’s breathe class where the base read the old micro-pulse class; the two parity specs read the same clock values exactly, cell by cell, where the base read a whole-clock line or substring that Round 7’s TimerFrame no longer draws. No toHaveTextContent→toBeInTheDocument, no exact→regex, no dropped count, no queryBy for getBy, no removed `not`, no conditional helper. The root specs keep every read: the Focus control by its exact Round 7 name (the build’s regex named the value too, which Round 7 puts in the control’s text), the Goal term exactly, the dialog’s one scroll owner by Round 7’s class (count kept). One whole case is retired under owner decision 7 (listed, not a weakened matcher). Repair round 1: 73 cases retired whole under D2 (ledger rows, no skip); two timing-only waits under D4(b) add reads and drop none.
rules.testUpdateRule: Eric, chat, 2026-11-23: “Yes, approve” — a test that expects Round 7 to look or read differently is updated to Round 7 (or only its look/wording part dropped where Round 7 has none); everything else it checks is kept, and each change is listed for UAT (evidence/refinement/task-115/UAT-LIST.md). A test that expects behaviour or saved data Round 7 lacks is reported, not changed.

s6Recheck.test: the ladder states its structure identity like every other block > names the structure, its cap and its scheme, and the block’s size
s6Recheck.result: The badge read `LADDER` (TASK-003, AC-C08-01) and the block-size read `1 movement` are kept; the build’s one detail read `8 MIN CAP · LADDER DOWN` is now Round 7’s meta line `3 rounds · 08:00 cap` and the scheme on the movement line `kettlebell swing · 15 → 9 reps · −3 per round` (rounds, cap and scheme readable outside the badge, AC-R003-01). Nothing TASK-110 owns was dropped; wording under the 2026-11-23 rule.

s6Recheck.test: AC-026: heading, counter, prescription and equipment > puts a subordinate Set X/Y counter in the name row beside the heading and equipment, then prescription
s6Recheck.result: Same five reads; the order read takes the heading’s name text (`back squat`) rather than the heading element, because Round 7’s heading also holds the counter. Name → equipment → prescription order still asserted. Nothing TASK-112 owns dropped.

s6Recheck.test: AC-035: borders and the countdown > frames the entry with the dialog’s one frame and the X with the action border (TASK-043)
s6Recheck.result: Seven reads at both revisions: the build’s frame class `clr-accepted-log__frame` and `.clr-set-log` inside are Round 7’s `clr-chamfer--lg` frame containing the sheet’s body. One frame, the X on the action border: kept. TASK-114’s frame work (C44/C57–C59) is asserted in its own logging-overlay cases; nothing dropped.

s6Recheck.test: a superset keeps its movements in the order the rows prescribe > labels them A1 and A2 by order_index, not by the order they arrived in
s6Recheck.result: The build’s `movementHeadings()` equal to ['A1 romanian deadlift', 'A2 back squat'] is `expectNamed(movementHeadingElements(), […])` with the same two names, in order (count and each accessible name). The TASK-005 link was the build helper’s exclusion of the coaching disclosure; Round 7 reads headings inside the movement list only. Nothing TASK-109 owns dropped.

s6Recheck.test: a superset whose movements were swapped out > still states the block’s rest and its remaining movement when one survives
s6Recheck.result: As above: ['A1 romanian deadlift'] through expectNamed; the rest and no-pairing reads are kept. Nothing dropped.

s6Recheck.test: TASK-010 completion choices and existing effort faces > AC-C29-01 Complete and Incomplete share one row in the For Time and ladder logs on the real /workout
s6Recheck.result: 30 build reads, 31 at the tip: the five CSS rule reads are the same rules with unquoted attribute selectors; `Start For Time` is Round 7’s `Start FOR TIME`; `form.dataset.timedFormat` is read on the flow’s scope (Round 7 puts it there); one read added (no ladder log before its attempt ends). Nothing TASK-117 owns dropped.

s6Recheck.test: TASK-010 completion choices and existing effort faces > AC-C30-01 effort is optional and unanswered stays null: the existing three faces with no default
s6Recheck.result: 27 reads at both revisions; the only change is Round 7’s wording `Clear effort for this section` (was `… for this block`). Nothing dropped.

s6Recheck.test: TASK-010 completion choices and existing effort faces > AC-R010-01 a failed save keeps the completion answer and the effort on screen, and the retry writes them
s6Recheck.result: 12 reads at both revisions; the failed dialog is now found by its name (/didn’t save/), a stricter read. Nothing dropped.

s6Recheck.test: TASK-013 rep-first ordered live ladder progress and result handoff > AC-R013-01 selecting a completed rung selects its preceding prefix and partial work belongs to the next round
s6Recheck.result: 21 reads at both revisions. The build’s `Any partial work belongs to round N` line (a removed ladder.tsx string, retired as a record claim by TASK-121) is read as Round 7’s per-movement amount field `Completed in round N` through partialRound() (TASK-015’s identity, at most one partial round): rounds 5, 7, 1 and none are still asserted, and the stored draft reads are the same on Round 7’s record name. Nothing TASK-117 owns dropped.

s6Recheck.test: a scheduled ladder runs on its own clock, restored from wall-clock time > marks the live round from the stored start, survives a remount, and records nothing on its own
s6Recheck.result: Every build read kept; one added (Incomplete chosen before the log’s save). The TASK-033 link was the build’s memoryStorage helper; Round 7 reads the real localStorage the route uses. Nothing TASK-120 owns dropped (TASK-120 changed no product).

s6Recheck.test: free-paced For Time never infers progress from elapsed time > $rounds rounds: no live round and no schedule, however long passes
s6Recheck.result: 16 reads at both revisions: storage reads on the real localStorage; `${rounds} rounds · for time, at your pace · cap` is Round 7’s `${rounds} rounds · cap` (the removed pacing words, R71); the timer `Block time` is `Ladder time`. Nothing dropped.

The spec held the clock at now + 1 s, where now is the page’s clock, which runs in real time from the gallery side’s resume through the /workout load; so the clock read 03:06, 03:07 or 03:08 at “running”, by load time. Reproduced before the fix: 4 parallel repeats on the shared dev server gave 3 × A and 1 × a third render C (698f17df/f34fe104/f375a680); A and C differ only in a 20×25 px box at the card’s top right, the clock’s last digit (03:07 vs 03:08). B’s images were overwritten in the store; that B was another reading is inferred.

repairRound4.failure: V2 verification of repair 3 (2bd7513a) passed every command twice (logs TASK-115-a1-r3-b1be3a52…, r3-3d895487…), but TASK-114’s capture workout-feedback-phone-320 (route-open) alternated between 31d5cb33… (committed at 2bd7513a) and 62c557be…; V2 committed run 1’s version as 318994cb (with TASK-115’s comparison receipt and page), and run 2 flipped them back.

cause.finding: Not the clock. TASK-114 already holds both sides at fixed instants (ENTRY + 60 s and ENTRY + 600 s); the coordinator’s “clock resumed while a clock is on screen” was an inference and did not hold. The route side held its clock as soon as <main> showed. /summary’s content could arrive after that (in 4 of 80 diagnostic runs the page had 80 or 130 elements instead of 256 at that point); the case then scrolled the control into view while the page laid the content out, so the scroller stopped at its maximum for a 12 px shorter page (scrollTop 133 of 613, against 145 of 625). The page behind the dialog sat 12 px lower; it shows through the dialog’s edges and chamfered corner, and the drawn scroll bar and CRT lines differ with it. Pixel diff 62c557be vs 31d5cb33: only the top 19 and bottom 27 CSS px and the right edge, values up to 49.
cause.sameFamily: movement-note at 320 and 390 (route-open) flipped the same way in the load probe (1 in 3 each) and with the unchanged spec at HEAD (1 in 40): the case pressed Add note at once after opening Coaching and notes, before that layout settled; the page behind the dialog’s lower edge differed.

fix.lines: 349–375 (settleRoute and its comment); 622–628 and 630–631 (route side: wait for the first control it presses, settleRoute, hold at ENTRY + 600 s, settleRoute again); 645–646 (movement note: settleRoute between Coaching and notes and Add note)
fix.change: Waits only. No read, receipt field, hash binding, tolerance or held instant changed.
fix.evidence: Diagnostics (a temporary copy of the spec, deleted): with the waits, 80 of 80 runs of workout-feedback 320 drew 31d5cb33 with the full page in place (256 elements); without them 4 of 80 started from a partial page and 3 drew 62c557be and 1 a third render. With the movement-note wait, 30 of 30 per width for movement-note 320/390 and workout-feedback 320/390.

scan.method: Every e2e/refinement parity spec read for the pattern (the real clock resumed or read while anything time-based is drawn in a hashed capture, or a hold taken before the route had settled); then 9 specs under load: npx playwright test task-103, 105, 106, 107, 111, 114, 116, 117 and 120 parity specs --project=mobile --repeat-each=3 --workers=6 on the shared 5173 server with placeholder Supabase URL/key, a hash reporter keyed by spec and capture: 294 passed, 1,266 captures under 422 names, every name byte-identical across its 3 repeats except TASK-114 movement-note 320 and 390 (route-open).
fixed: TASK-114 (workout-feedback, movement-note; the route side’s readiness)
checkedNotChanged: TASK-105: reads the page’s own now before Start (TASK-104’s old shape), but nothing in its hashed captures depends on the absolute instant: run with the holds moved to fixed instants 3+ minutes later (a trial edit, reverted), all 12 receipts came out byte-identical to the committed ones. No pattern; not changed.

TASK-103, TASK-116, TASK-117: the clock installed at the real time, the session started a minute before it, so everything drawn is relative; no route capture is taller than the viewport (no header clock over a capture); stable in the probe. Not changed.
TASK-106, TASK-107, TASK-111, TASK-120: fixed held instants; the route side waits for the very card or region it drives before holding; stable in the probe. Not changed.

TASK-104 (fixed in round 2) and TASK-108, TASK-110, TASK-112, TASK-118 and TASK-115’s comparison (setFixedTime): no real clock. TASK-113: no clock and nothing time-based. TASK-109, TASK-119: real dates used only relative to today, no date drawn. Not changed.
scan.limit: Three repeats per case cannot rule out a flip rarer than about 1 in 20 in the specs not changed.
